description: The file 'strmap.h' provides the declaration of a string-to-pointer map data structure and associated operations, including specialized variants like string-int maps and string sets. It defines structures, inline functions, and macros for managing string-based hash maps, emphasizing memory management and efficiency.

methods.name: cmp_strmap_entry
methods.description: Comparison function used for hash map entries, fundamental for key comparison within the hashmap.

methods.name: strmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a strmap, setting up its internal hashmap and allocation options.

methods.name: strmap_init_with_options
methods.description: Initializes a strmap with specified memory pool and string duplication behavior.

methods.name: strmap_clear
methods.description: Removes all entries from the map, optionally freeing associated values.

methods.name: strmap_partial_clear
methods.description: Clears entries but retains table allocation for future use.

methods.name: strmap_put
methods.description: Inserts key-value pairs into the map, overwriting existing entries if needed.

methods.name: strmap_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the map entry associated with a given key.

methods.name: strmap_get
methods.description: Fetches the data pointer associated with a key.

methods.name: strmap_contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map (regardless of value).

methods.name: strmap_remove
methods.description: Removes a key (and optionally its value) from the map.

methods.name: unsigned int strmap_get_size(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the map.

methods.name: int strmap_empty(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Checks whether the map is empty.

methods.name: void strintmap_init(struct strintmap * map,int default_value)
methods.description: Initializes a string-to-integer map with a default value.

methods.name: void strintmap_init_with_options(struct strintmap * map,int default_value,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a strintmap with additional memory and string duplication options.

methods.name: void strintmap_clear(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Clears the strintmap, removing all entries.

methods.name: void strintmap_partial_clear(struct strintmap * map)
methods.description: Partially clears the strintmap, retaining table allocation.

methods.name: int strintmap_contains(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a key is present in the strintmap.

methods.name: void strintmap_remove(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Removes a key from the strintmap.

methods.name: int strintmap_get(struct strintmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or returns the default if not found.

methods.name: void strintmap_set(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t v)
methods.description: Associates a key with a value in the strintmap.

methods.name: strintmap_incr
methods.description: Increments the integer value associated with a key, adding the key if absent.

methods.name: void strset_init(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Initializes a string set.

methods.name: void strset_init_with_options(struct strset * set,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initializes a string set with options for memory management.

methods.name: void strset_clear(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Clears all entries in the string set.

methods.name: void strset_partial_clear(struct strset * set)
methods.description: Partially clears the set, retaining table allocation.

methods.name: int strset_contains(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Checks if a string is in the set.

methods.name: void strset_remove(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Removes a string from the set.

methods.name: strset_add
methods.description: Adds a string to the set, returns 1 if added, 0 if already present.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
